subject.title: feat(ui): session dashboard shell — board face, chat dock, reset guard

question: Should the dashboard host land as a separately staged no-provider shell, or should it wait until the board renderer and gateway provider can be reviewed as one integrated user flow?
rationale: The branch deliberately introduces a user-facing shell whose full production board path is owned by still-open companion work, so merge sequencing and the permanent provider boundary require maintainer intent.

options.title: Stage the shell now
options.body: Accept the null-provider shell once browser proof confirms existing chat sessions remain unchanged and the renderer contract is pinned for the follow-up PRs.

options.title: Review the dashboard as one integrated flow
options.body: Hold this host until the board renderer and provider wiring can demonstrate the complete end-user dashboard workflow together.

recommendation.title: Review the dashboard as one integrated flow
recommendation.body: Hold this host until the board renderer and provider wiring can demonstrate the complete end-user dashboard workflow together.

likelyOwner.reason: The available branch and sibling-PR history ties steipete most directly to the proposed dashboard contract and its staged implementation.
